_comment: Copy this file to config.json and set sqIp to the mixer's address. Environment variables override anything here: SQ5_IP, SQ5_PORT, SQ5_MIDI_CHANNEL, WS_PORT, SQ5_MAX_DB.
_maxDb: The level a fader at the very top reaches. 0 is unity and is the default. The mixer will go to +10, but letting performers push their own wedge 10 dB past unity is how you get feedback during a service - raise this deliberately or not at all.
